examples.english: My team won this important match.
examples.transliteration: Fareeqy keseb el match el mohem da

examples.arabic: سارة قالت أنا هروق الشقة وأجهز الغدا بدري عشان عندي مشوار مهم
examples.english: Sara said: I will tidy the apartment and prepare lunch early because I have an important errand.
examples.transliteration: Sara qalet ana ha-rawwaq el-shaqqa w aghahhez el-ghada badri ashan andi meshwar mohem.

examples.arabic: صباح النور يا مدام سارة معلش عندي مشوار مهم ومحدش فاضي يوصلني
examples.english: Good morning, Mrs. Sara, sorry, I have an important errand and no one is free to drive me.
examples.transliteration: Sabah el noor ya madam Sara, ma'lesh 'andy meshwar mohem we mahaddesh fady yewassalny.

examples.arabic: العيلة كلها خططت تتفرج على ماتش كورة مهم
examples.english: The whole family planned to watch an important football match.
examples.transliteration: El-3eila kolleha khaTTat tetfarag 3ala match koora mohem.

examples.arabic: امبارح كنت بتفرج على ماتش كورة مهم في التليفزيون
examples.english: Yesterday I was watching an important football match on TV
examples.transliteration: Imbaareh kont batfarraj ala match koora mohimm fi el-televezyoun

examples.arabic: مهم نختار رئيس الجمهورية اللي يقود البلد كويس
examples.english: It's important to choose the President of the Republic who will lead the country well.
examples.transliteration: Mohimm nekhtār raʾīs el-gomhūrīya elli yaʾūd el-balad kwayyis.
